title: x402 Treasury Experiments
description: Pre-registered measurements of the cost and friction of converting accumulated L2 USDC micropayment revenue into spendable fiat. Each experiment is committed before it runs: a protocol and operator runbook are fixed in git, raw observations are collected verbatim into sessions, and the analyzed record validates against a published schema. The usdc-fiat-sweep-api experiment (v1.0.1) converted 8 tranches totaling $157.25908 USDC to USD via the Coinbase Advanced Trade convert API: the convert fee quoted and charged was $0.00, the realized fee was 0.00%, and the USD spread was 0% on every tranche from $1 to the full wallet balance; the only realized cost was Base gas (~$0.31). Includes the pre-registered protocol and runbook, the 9 run records (8 executed, 1 pre-registered not_executed) with verbatim raw API artifacts, the frozen figure recipes, and figures 1-2 (figure 3, fee decomposition, is intentionally absent because every cost component is zero).
